use_case: AI-driven alert triage and automated containment in the MDR provider's platform: scores alerts, writes summaries, auto-closes low-scoring alerts, and can isolate a laptop or suspend an identity account on its own
vendor_or_model: MDR provider platform feature (machine learning scoring plus a generative summary model), configured by the provider
data_categories: EDR telemetry from 9 laptops; identity provider sign-ins (staff names, devices, IP addresses); firewall and VPN connection metadata, including customer IP addresses. No customer VM contents or bank customer information
affects_individuals: Yes (employees through user-behavior alerts and automated suspensions; customers and banks indirectly if attacks are missed)
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (security monitoring of hosting and managed services for about 70 customers, including 2 banks)
human_in_the_loop: Today: about 91% of alerts auto-closed with no human review; automated containment with no call first. Conditions: no auto-close for protected categories; monthly 50-alert sample; call-first before suspending the on-call engineer; break-glass accounts excluded
applicable_laws: Bank contracts (Interagency Guidelines III.C.1.f, III.D.2); MSA confidentiality clause; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims); no state AI employment law applies (Florida staff; no employment use)
status: In production since 2025-11; approved with conditions 2026-09-15
